title: LingoLLM / Hire a Linguist!
primary_evidence: Primary paper describes dictionary, grammar and morphological evidence; repository README exposes direct/few-shot/dictionary modes.
proposed_use: Test independently verified language knowledge with matched strong-model prompts.
limitations: Manchu-specific dictionary acquisition and incomplete release documentation; implementation files and revisions were not inspected in this lane; no Pahlavi validation.
evidence_level: Primary paper or artifact documentation; no local model execution

title: PahGen: Generating Ancient Pahlavi Text via Grammar-guided Zero-shot Translation
primary_evidence: English-to-Pahlavi grammar-guided LLM framework and expert-validated synthetic dataset; inspected paper and release distinction.
proposed_use: Task-specific baseline and contact/bibliography lead for subsequent authorized collaboration.
limitations: Narrow vocabulary-filtered evaluation; paper/release count discrepancy remains; dataset release is not a pretrained translation model. No contact made.
evidence_level: Primary paper or artifact documentation; no local model execution

title: GlossLM code and models referenced by GrammaMT
primary_evidence: GrammaMT uses externally generated language-specific glosses and points to this project/model collection.
proposed_use: Acquire or create trustworthy Pahlavi lexical/morphological supervision and compare gloss sources.
limitations: Pahlavi checkpoint and exact implementation/configuration not verified; translation-prompting being training-free does not mean gloss generation needs no training.
evidence_level: Primary paper or artifact documentation; no local model execution

title: Apollo Restore; Aeneas restoration/contextualization
primary_evidence: Primary descriptions address restoring missing Greek text and contextualizing ancient inscriptions.
proposed_use: Borrow evidence presentation and uncertainty ideas while keeping translation evaluation separate.
limitations: Restoration accuracy, including top-k short-gap results, is not contextual Pahlavi translation accuracy.
evidence_level: Primary paper or artifact documentation; no local model execution

title: MITRA parallel corpus v2 documentation
primary_evidence: README documents 1,693,730 aligned records / 2,338,400 segment pairs plus filtering, provenance, deduplication and decontamination.
proposed_use: Corpus-alignment and lineage design precedent; investigate actual code before reuse.
limitations: Documentation inspected, implementation not inspected; Pali excluded in v2. This is a later artifact of the MITRA project, not independent corroboration of the January study.
evidence_level: Primary paper or artifact documentation; no local model execution

title: ByT5 released model sizes
primary_evidence: Official repository specifies ByT5-XL at approximately 3.7 billion parameters.
proposed_use: Size an eligible larger byte-level translation adaptation candidate.
limitations: Parameter size establishes only a memory-accounting input; actual training fit, quality and throughput require profiling.
evidence_level: Primary paper or artifact documentation; no local model execution
